scoreMeaning: 100 means every configured buyer-readiness control is evidence-backed or explicitly human-attested. It is not a legal-compliance guarantee.

controls.title: Product identity and intended purpose
controls.remediation: Publish a precise product description, intended users, intended purpose and explicit non-goals.

controls.title: AI Act role and risk classification
controls.remediation: Record whether the organisation acts as provider, deployer, importer/distributor or downstream provider and document the current risk-classification rationale.

controls.title: AI interaction disclosure
controls.remediation: Ensure people are clearly informed when they directly interact with AI where Article 50 or buyer policy requires it.

controls.title: Human oversight and authority boundary
controls.remediation: Document which actions AI may prepare, which actions require human approval and who has final authority.

controls.title: Model and AI vendor inventory
controls.remediation: Maintain an inventory of models, AI providers, purpose, data sent, hosting region where known and fallback/replacement path.

controls.title: Subprocessor inventory
controls.remediation: Publish or maintain a current list of subprocessors and the purpose for which each receives customer data.

controls.title: Data-flow and data-boundary documentation
controls.remediation: Describe inputs, storage, model/provider calls, outputs, logs and deletion paths, including what never leaves the customer boundary.

controls.title: Retention and deletion controls
controls.remediation: Define retention periods, deletion triggers, tenant deletion behavior and exceptions such as legally required records.

controls.title: DPA and technical-organisational measures package
controls.remediation: Prepare buyer-facing DPA/TOM starter material and have company-specific legal terms reviewed before relying on it contractually.

controls.title: Security contact and vulnerability intake
controls.remediation: Publish a monitored security contact and a simple vulnerability-reporting path.

controls.title: Security and AI incident response
controls.remediation: Document incident triage, containment, customer notification decision points, evidence preservation and post-incident review.

controls.title: Authentication, authorization and tenant isolation
controls.remediation: Show how identities bind to roles/tenants and how cross-tenant or unauthorised access fails closed.

controls.title: Auditability and consequential-action trace
controls.remediation: Keep a durable trace of evidence, tool calls, approvals and consequential actions without leaking secrets into logs.

controls.title: Evaluations, limitations and known failure modes
controls.remediation: Publish what has been evaluated, sample sizes, important failure modes, unproven areas and release gates.

controls.title: Buyer-facing trust centre
controls.remediation: Create one buyer-facing page that links current security, privacy, AI governance, reliability and contact evidence.

controls.title: Reusable security and AI questionnaire answer library
controls.remediation: Maintain approved answers with evidence links so repeated buyer questionnaires can be completed without inventing claims.
